reason: Pax 0.x: removes `pydantic_ai_pax.runtime.session.folder_authority`, the helper `coder`'s project skills used to read the session folder's trust authority when a capability function's workspace was attached only after `Skills` read its catalog. That workspace is now attached before `for_run`, so the helper has no caller. It was undocumented and never part of the plugin API; the trust authority on Pax's `LocalWorkspace` stays.
